name: Data stores: Elasticsearch -> CouchDB -> Solr (+ admin panels fallback)
goal: Sweep unauthenticated data-plane stores for direct database reads.
preconditions: Data stores reachable (HTTP APIs: ES/CouchDB/Solr; TCP-only stores documented as gaps).
impact: Direct read of application data: indices, documents, DB lists.

steps.purpose: ES cluster/indices read via /_cat/indices + search endpoints.
steps.on_success: Document-level extraction; look for user/password indices.

steps.purpose: Solr admin cores listing; query endpoints follow.
steps.on_success: Cores -> query extraction; velocity RCE (documented variant) as escalation.
steps.on_fail: None reachable -> TCP-only stores (Mongo/Redis/postgres) are documented gaps (need TCP tooling); pivot to admin panels shelf.

steps.purpose: Fallback: exposed DB consoles often yield the same data plane with creds found elsewhere (recon-secrets-to-cloud).
steps.on_fail: Try Adminer (infra/Adminer db manager exposed), H2 console (redteam/H2 database console exposed).

entry_points: internal service names from recon chains

recon.name: Canonical endpoint sweep
recon.how: One curl list across all datastore ports/paths per host.

recon.name: Banner version triage
recon.how: Version strings select CVE-era escalations (Solr velocity, CouchDB 12635).

recon.name: Kibana/monitoring adjacency
recon.how: Kibana/monitoring panels often sit beside ES and leak index names.

recon.name: Backup dump pairing
recon.how: Dump.sql/backup artifacts (secrets_exposure shelf) pair with store findings for full datasets.
recon.signal: Artifact + live store = same dataset twice.

pivot_hints: store creds -> datastore reuse across services
